injected_fault.description: The network link from order-service to payment-service (through Toxiproxy) is disabled, so connections are refused. Checkout needs a payment authorisation and fails; browsing does not touch payment-service and keeps working.

root_cause.summary: order-service cannot connect to payment-service, so payment authorisation fails and checkout returns errors through api-gateway and frontend; payment-service itself receives no traffic, and catalogue browsing is unaffected.

expected_symptoms.description: order-service error logs: payment-service is unavailable (connection failed), for 1 minute.

order-service client spans to payment-service fail with ConnectError (no HTTP response at all). Note: a refused connection records no http.client duration sample, so this is visible in traces and logs, not in that metric (verified live).
Checkout fails: api-gateway POST /api/orders 5xx share above 50% for 1 minute.
expected_symptoms.query: (sum(rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{service_name="api-gateway", http_route=~"/api/orders", http_request_method="POST", http_response_status_code=~"5.."}[1m])) or vector(0)) / sum(rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{service_name="api-gateway", http_route=~"/api/orders", http_request_method="POST"}[1m]))

expected_symptoms.description: payment-service receives (almost) no requests for 2 minutes.
order-service POST /orders traces with a 503 server span (payment authorisation failed).
Browsing keeps working: frontend product pages 5xx share stays below 1%.

recovery_checks.query: (sum(rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{service_name="api-gateway", http_route=~"/api/orders", http_request_method="POST", http_response_status_code=~"5.."}[1m])) or vector(0)) / sum(rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{service_name="api-gateway", http_route=~"/api/orders", http_request_method="POST"}[1m]))
